About Rosenbauer

Rosenbauer is the world's leading manufacturer of firefighting equipment for fire protection and disaster control. For more than 160 years, the name has stood for significant innovations and groundbreaking technologies in the construction of fire engines and firefighting equipment according to European and US standards.

Company profile
Rosenbauer has stood for innovation, quality and safety for over 160 years, combining tradition with technological excellence.

About Rosenbauer

Rosenbauer is the world's leading manufacturer of firefighting equipment for fire protection and disaster control

Rosenbauer continues to develop genuine innovations and sets new standards with technically advanced solutions - And this has been the case for over 160 years. As a system supplier, Rosenbauer offers the best and most reliable solution for every conceivable application. Be it in the areas of equipment, fire extinguishers, firefighting vehicles, emergency management or fire protection.
